notes: syncEdges: none made by this service. server.cpp registers only two gRPC services (server.cpp:246 RegisterService(&currencyService), server.cpp:247 RegisterService(&healthService)) and contains no client stub. The RPCs it serves are declared at pb/demo.proto:140-142. CMakeLists.txt:64-69 links gRPC::grpc++ for serving only. The stage-1 edge currencyservice to otelcol (.env:27) is telemetry export, not a synchronous service call, so it is reported under exportsTelemetryTo.

messaging: none. No Kafka or other messaging client in server.cpp or CMakeLists.txt:64-69. docker-compose.yml:181-185 passes no KAFKA_SERVICE_ADDR and docker-compose.yml:186-188 depends_on lists only otelcol.

registry, discovery, coordinator: none. server.cpp has no registration code and docker-compose.yml:166-189 has no registry key. Callers reach this service by address only (CURRENCY_SERVICE_ADDR at .env:64 is consumed by other services).

health: no healthcheck key in docker-compose.yml:166-189. The process serves a gRPC health service: HealthServer at server.cpp:91 sets SERVING in Check at server.cpp:98 and is registered at server.cpp:247. It answers on request. These files contain no heartbeat thread, failure timeout or cleanup interval, so heartbeat independence from work does not apply.

container and port: src/currencyservice/Dockerfile:47-48 EXPOSE and ENTRYPOINT use CURRENCY_SERVICE_PORT. .env:63 sets CURRENCY_SERVICE_PORT=7001. docker-compose.yml:179-180 publishes it. server.cpp:241 binds 0.0.0.0. docker-compose.yml:177 sets memory limit 20M (not in schema).

telemetry traces: tracer_common.h:75 creates OtlpGrpcExporterFactory::Create() with no options, and tracer_common.h:77 wraps it in SimpleSpanProcessorFactory::Create (per-span export; timing is library behaviour, not in these files). The endpoint comes from OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, which the exporter reads from the environment. Behaviour when unset: library default, not in these files.

telemetry metrics: meter_common.h:22-23 creates OtlpGrpcMetricExporterFactory::Create(otlpOptions) with default options. meter_common.h:26-28 uses a PeriodicExportingMetricReader with default PeriodicExportingMetricReaderOptions. The export interval is not set in these files: library default, not in these files. server.cpp:267 calls initMeter().

telemetry logs: logger_common.h:21-22 creates OtlpGrpcLogRecordExporterFactory::Create(loggerOptions) with default options, and logger_common.h:23 uses SimpleLogRecordProcessorFactory (per-record export; timing is library behaviour, not in these files). server.cpp:268 calls initLogger().
collector receive side: otelcol-config.yml:8 sets the gRPC OTLP receiver endpoint to OTEL_COLLECTOR_HOST:OTEL_COLLECTOR_PORT_GRPC, which resolves to otelcol:4317 (.env:27-28).

export gating: modules/otel-demo/deployment/compose.candidate-postures.yml:46-52 (harness repo) sets OTEL_PLACEMENT_ENABLED, OTEL_SDK_DISABLED, OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER, OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER and OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER from OTEL_CANDIDATE_CURRENCYSERVICE_* variables whose values are not in these files. server.cpp reads only VERSION (server.cpp:85), so whether export happens depends on those unstated values and on library behaviour, not in these files.
replicas: no deploy.replicas or scale key in docker-compose.yml:166-189, and none in compose.candidate-postures.yml:46-52. Library default, not in these files.

role.note: gRPC server implementing oteldemo.CurrencyService (pb/demo.proto:140); it makes no outbound calls

replicas.note: absent: no deploy.replicas or scale key in the currencyservice block (docker-compose.yml:166-189; its deploy block at :174-177 sets only resources.limits.memory). Library default, not in these files; Compose default 1.

exportsTelemetryTo.note: Resolves the OTEL_COLLECTOR_HOST reference in OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT (.env:32 gives http://otelcol:4317; port at .env:28). Passed to the service by the bare entry at docker-compose.yml:184. Export is gated by the candidate posture variables (see extraction.notes).
